steps.code:
# Count unique songs per artist
from collections import defaultdict
artist_song_count = defaultdict(int)
for sid, artists in song_artists.items():
    for artist in artists:
        artist_song_count[artist] += 1

# Sort artists by count descending, then by name for deterministic tie-breaking
sorted_artists = sorted(artist_song_count.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
print("Top artists by unique song count:")
for artist, count in sorted_artists[:10]:
    print(f"{artist}: {count}")
